From the Principal's Desk
Globalization is a blizzard which has topsy-turvied every department in the Post-modern Era. Education too is not an exception; it has crossed all delimitations and boundaries and become international in spirit. It has become a challenge and poses challenges. To keep pace with this trend moving at rat-race speed Nehru College (Recognized by UGC and duly accredited by NAAC) has employed all the resources to achieve academic excellence and is marching forward steadily to scale new heights.
The College has already completed 48 years of being in the field of education since its inception in 1965 and achieved maximum goals of improvement and sustenance. To strictly implement the NAAC guidelines for Higher Education as a stake-holder, the college is looking at engaging the students in overall developmental process.With the experience and wisdom gained during the last 45 years, we have been able to design co-curricular and extracurricular activities for the students to be involved actively in such activities as would benefit themselves as well as their families, societies and the nation at large.
